items.title: Wikipedia (Full English)
items.subtitle: All 6.8M articles, with images
items.description: The complete English Wikipedia. Every article, full images. The single most valuable thing on the drive.

items.title: Wikipedia (Top 1M Articles)
items.subtitle: Most-read 1M articles, with images
items.description: If you can't fit the full 124 GB Wikipedia, this is the next best thing. The most-read million articles cover ~95% of what people actually look up.

items.title: Wikipedia (Simple English)
items.subtitle: Basic English version, kid-friendly
items.description: Wikipedia rewritten in simple English. Useful for younger readers or as a fast lookup when you don't need the full article.

items.title: Wiktionary
items.subtitle: English dictionary + translations
items.description: Comprehensive English dictionary with etymologies, pronunciations, and translations to and from dozens of languages.

items.title: Wikiquote
items.subtitle: Sourced quotations
items.description: Sourced quotations from notable people, books, films, and proverbs.

items.title: WikiMed Medical Encyclopedia
items.subtitle: Wikipedia's medical articles, curated
items.description: Curated medical reference. Symptoms, diagnoses, treatments, drug information. Designed for offline clinical use in low-resource settings.

items.title: iFixit Repair Guides
items.subtitle: Step-by-step repair manuals
items.description: Fix anything. Phones, laptops, appliances, vehicles. Hundreds of step-by-step guides with photos.

items.title: Survivor Library
items.subtitle: Pre-industrial knowledge archive
items.description: Books on farming, blacksmithing, medicine, construction. Knowledge from before the grid existed. Massive (252 GB) but priceless if things go sideways.

items.title: Learning Self-Reliance
items.subtitle: Practical homesteading guides
items.description: Practical guides on gardening, food preservation, shelter, water purification, and self-sufficiency.

items.title: US Army Field Manuals

items.description: US Army Publishing Directorate manuals: first aid, navigation, survival, fieldcraft, equipment maintenance. Public domain.

items.title: Canadian Prepper
items.subtitle: Bug-out and emergency planning
items.description: Emergency preparedness, bug-out bag concepts, survival skills.

items.title: Khan Academy (Full)
items.subtitle: Math, science, economics, history
items.description: Free world-class lessons from elementary through college level. Includes videos, exercises, and explanations.

items.title: CrashCourse Videos
items.subtitle: Engaging educational video series
items.description: Hank and John Green's educational video series covering history, science, literature, and more.

items.title: Wikibooks
items.subtitle: Open-content textbooks
items.description: Open-content textbooks on every subject, from cookbooks to programming languages to academic disciplines.

items.title: Wikiversity
items.subtitle: Free learning materials and courses
items.description: Course materials, lesson plans, and learning projects from beginner through graduate level.

items.title: PhET Interactive Simulations
items.subtitle: Interactive physics & chemistry sims

items.title: VOA Learning English
items.subtitle: Slow-spoken English for learners

items.subtitle: Source texts: laws, treaties, classics

items.subtitle: Computer enthusiast Q&A

items.title: Server Fault
items.subtitle: Sysadmin & DevOps Q&A

items.subtitle: Unix/Linux command-line Q&A

items.title: Electronics Stack Exchange
items.subtitle: Circuits & electronics Q&A

items.title: Cheatography

items.title: MediaWiki Documentation

items.title: Mathematics Stack Exchange
items.subtitle: Math Q&A from algebra to PhD
items.description: Q&A on every level of mathematics, from arithmetic to research-level theory.

items.title: Physics Stack Exchange
items.subtitle: Physics Q&A
items.description: Q&A on classical mechanics, quantum, relativity, thermodynamics.

items.title: GIS Stack Exchange

items.subtitle: Tech-focused TED talks
